name: Homemade Tortilla Chips
desc: Corn tortilla wedges baked or fried until crisp and salted while hot.

source.title: How to Make Tortilla Chips
source.evidence: Culinary Hill's older baked chips URL now redirects to this page, which keeps the same method (6 wedges per tortilla, bake 350°F for 6 minutes, flip, 6 to 10 more; or fry at 350°F) at a smaller 8-tortilla batch.

ingredients.raw: Vegetable, corn, or canola oil for frying, 1/4 to 1/2 inch deep in a heavy skillet (fry method only)

steps: Bake method: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with foil.
Bake method: Brush the tortillas lightly on one side with the olive oil and stack them 6 high. Cut each stack into 6 wedges.
Bake method: Spread the wedges in a single layer on the sheets and sprinkle with salt. Bake 6 minutes, then turn the chips with tongs.
Bake method: Sprinkle again with salt and bake 6 to 10 minutes more, until lightly browned and crisp. Repeat in batches with the remaining wedges.
Fry method: Stack the tortillas (no olive oil) and cut each stack into 6 wedges. Heat the frying oil in a heavy skillet or deep fryer to 350°F.

Fry method: Fry a handful of wedges at a time, without crowding, until lightly golden and crisp, 1 to 2 minutes. Lift out with a slotted spoon onto paper towels and salt while hot. Repeat with the rest.
tips: Chips keep crisping as they cool; pull them when lightly golden.

references.title: How to Make Tortilla Chips
